title: Adopt in Cyclotron
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Same pattern in Cyclotron's own account: operator listener, catalog, table, SES identity, last-resort alerts; app events (a retrain finished, a decision queue backed up). SES sandbox on 2026-11-04: fine for verified operators. Cyclotron's session owns the merge and takes approval from Ryan directly. No SNS topic found by source search.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started.
